## Independent model choices
The transcript, review, fix and resolve actions each keep their own model selection. Changing one no longer changes the others, and an action's default no longer follows the transcript's pick.
## Reports from subthreads
A subthread can now send an optional report back to the thread that started it, and the parent receives it as clearly attributed input.
## Better guidance for splitting work
Threads working on the default branch now know how to hand work to a subthread so it becomes its own branch and pull request, and how to leave the default branch back in step with the remote afterwards.

## More flexible worktrees
Continue a conversation in an existing worktree and choose its model, or let separate Auto Fix jobs work on different changes at the same time. Detached worktrees remain readable, with clear notices when an action cannot safely write there.
## Clearer pull request reviews
Review actions now check the branch state before proceeding, and the review panel keeps its checkout information consistent while work is running.

## Continue a thread in an existing worktree
Pick up a thread in a worktree you already have instead of creating a new one, and cleaning up a finished worktree no longer freezes the window.
## Clearer review panel
Finding cards use icon buttons and show who reported each finding, the review panel uses switches, and you can choose how review action icons are labelled. Kulula also finds your pull requests after a thread turn and stops polling checkouts and pull requests while it is idle.
## Easier settings
Settings sections, routing controls and review defaults are tidied, you can pick a third level of model effort, and Add Repository opens its folder pickers as sheets.
